description: High-growth enterprise SaaS earnings call with subscription gross margin expansion and Q4 revenue range guidance.
current_transcript: Operator: Good afternoon and welcome to the CloudScale Systems third quarter 2026 earnings conference call. Turning to our third quarter financial results, CloudScale delivered total revenue of $300 million for the quarter, reflecting durable enterprise demand. Subscription gross margin improved to 75 percent. Annual recurring revenue reached $1.20 billion across our cloud portfolio. For the upcoming fourth quarter of 2026, management expects revenue between $315 million and $325 million. Enterprise customer expansion in North America remained strong with net retention above 115 percent.

historical_transcripts.label: Q3 2025
historical_transcripts.transcript: Operator: Welcome to CloudScale Systems Q3 2025 earnings call. For the third quarter of 2025, total revenue was $250 million. Subscription gross margin was 72 percent during the prior year period. Annual recurring revenue stood at $1.00 billion. Commercial sales activity was solid across core customer accounts.

expected_facts.expected_quote_substring: Subscription gross margin improved to 75 percent
